title: 阿亚拉CEO：联手三菱，要打造资产生态圈？
speaker: Cezar Consing

segments.en: Yes, we've already identified the segments that we'll focus on. We'll focus on real estate, we'll focus on energy, we'll focus on fintech, financial services in general, mobility, logistics, AI.
segments.zh: 是的，我们已经确定了重点板块：地产、能源、金融科技、整体金融服务、出行、物流、人工智能。

segments.en: Right, they match a portfolio. But more importantly, we'll not only focus on individual assets but we'll focus on trying to create an ecosystem with these assets.
segments.zh: 它们与我们的组合匹配。但更重要的是，我们不仅关注单个资产，还致力于用这些资产打造一个生态圈。

segments.en: Because we can certainly create value asset by asset, but what is more exciting is actually if we can create an ecosystem with the portfolio of assets that we have.
segments.zh: 因为逐个资产当然能创造价值，但更令人兴奋的是，我们能以现有资产组合打造一个生态圈。

segments.en: Tell us more, tell us more. Well, look, this is a seven hundred million dollar investment, it's about one hundred twenty billion yen.
segments.zh: 再多讲讲。好的，这是一笔七亿美元的投资，约合一千两百亿日元。

segments.en: I think it's the largest FDI that the Philippines will be getting, has gotten year to date. Okay, certainly for Ayala it's extremely significant.
segments.zh: 我认为这是菲律宾今年迄今获得的最大一笔外商直接投资。对阿亚拉来说，这极其重要。

segments.en: You know, this is a real bet on our company and on our country. Mitsubishi at one point owned twenty percent of our stock and over time they managed their portfolio so their holding came down.
segments.zh: 这是对我们公司和国家的真正押注。三菱曾一度持有我们百分之二十的权益，后来管理组合，持仓下降。

segments.en: And a few years ago they were down to, and today they were down to four point seven percent. But they look at the situation now, they look at the demographics of the country, they look at the potential for good macro.
segments.zh: 几年前降到，今天降到百分之四点七。但他们看现在的局面，看国家的人口结构，看良好宏观的潜力。

segments.en: They look at how Ayala is positioned, they look at the trust that people have in our company and in our businesses, they look at how we've begun to work the assets much harder.
segments.zh: 他们看阿亚拉的定位，看人们对公司和业务的信任，看我们如何更努力地经营资产。

segments.en: They've looked at the rationalization moves that we've made and they've said, they've agreed with us, this is the time, right, this is the time to bet big on Ayala and on the Philippines.
segments.zh: 他们看了我们做的结构优化举措，同意我们的判断：现在是重仓阿亚拉和菲律宾的时候。

segments.en: Mitsubishi, these are long term players, right, this is long term money, long long term money. In the same way that Ayala is a two hundred year, almost a two hundred year old company committed to the Philippines.
segments.zh: 三菱是长期参与者，这是长期资金，超长期资金。阿亚拉也一样，是近两百年历史、扎根菲律宾的公司。

segments.en: We're talking long term value creation here and we'll do it in a way that frankly shareholders should see even in the short term. So we're talking long term value creation but they should see results in the short term.
segments.zh: 我们谈的是长期价值创造，而且要以股东在短期也能看到的方式来做。长期价值创造，但短期就应见成果。

segments.en: Right, by paying down debt, by being rigorous with our ROE requirements and the part of various business units, by demanding more dividends, by distributing more dividends to shareholders.
segments.zh: 通过偿还债务、严格各业务单元的回报率要求、争取更多分红、向股东分配更多分红。

segments.en: And by frankly doing a better job of communicating what we want to do in the short term and in the medium term. I think we'll create the kind of value for shareholders in the short and medium term.
segments.zh: 并更清晰地沟通我们在短期和中期的计划。我认为我们能在短期和中期为股东创造那类价值。

segments.en: And it certainly has been a concern especially of late, Mr. Consing. And I think you started, we started the interview and you alluded to the fact that they had to look at maybe the share price and said there was value there.
segments.zh: 康辛先生，这确实是近期市场关注点。访谈开始时您也提到，他们看权益资产价格，认为有价值。

segments.en: Can I just ask, and people have been trying to figure out why there's been so much value erosion in the markets locally there. I mean your share price, not total return, share price itself.
segments.zh: 能否问一下，人们一直在想为什么当地市场估值压缩这么多。是权益资产价格本身，不是总回报。

segments.en: I think AC is down by fifty percent from the peak. We've been talking a lot about Ayala Land for example, that's another example. Why do you think that's going on, what's happening?
segments.zh: AC从高点回落约百分之五十。比如阿亚拉地产也是例子。您认为原因是什么？
